parts.text: Plec din Cluj la Viena pe 10 octombrie cu un Logan pe benzină, Euro 4, și mă întorc pe 18. Ce trebuie să cumpăr?

Pe scurt — trei lucruri care decid dacă primiți amendă:

1) România: rovinietă 10 zile (categoria A) — 35 RON, valabil 10.10.2026–19.10.2026 (acoperă plecare și întoarcere). Cumpărați prin TollRo/CNAIR (din 1 oct 2026 sistemul oficial), atenție: exista un proiect în Senat care ar fi putut amâna startul; verificat la 29.09.2026. [CNAIR (RO)](https://www.cnadnr.ro/en/node/15933) — [Ordinul MTI 888/2026](https://lege5.ro/Gratuit/ge4tqnzthazti/ordinul-nr-888-2026-pentru-aprobarea-categoriilor-de-vehicule-si-a-nivelului-rovinietei)

2) Ungaria: e‑vigneta D1, 10‑day — 6.900 HUF (valabil 10.10–19.10.2026). Trebuie cumpărată înainte de a intra pe autostradă; introduceți corect numărul de înmatriculare și codul țării (RO). Sancțiune: suprataxă dacă nu aveți vigneta (27.790–95.730 HUF). [NemzetiÚtdíj (HU)](https://nemzetiutdij.hu/api/uploads/e_matrica_arak_2026_pdf_611db0ecc1.pdf)

3) Austria: vinieta 10‑day pentru autoturism — 12,80 EUR. Introduceți exact numărul de înmatriculare la achiziție; o greșeală contează ca lipsă vinietă (Ersatzmaut 200 EUR pentru autoturisme). [ASFINAG (AT)](https://media.asfinag.at/media/xq0lud1b/asf_vignettenfolder_2026_en.pdf)

Alte obligații importante: pașaport/CI la control la frontieră; în România — trusă de prim-ajutor, 2 triunghiuri reflectorizante şi stingător; în Austria — trusă, triunghi şi vestă reflectorizantă; în Ungaria toleranță 0,0 alcool. Surse oficiale în cardul planului (verificat 29.09.2026). Atenție la detaliile de plată și introducerea corectă a plăcii.
Ich fahre am 20. Dezember mit meinem Diesel (Euro 5) von Brașov nach München und am 3. Januar zurück. Reichen M+S-Reifen?

Kurz: M+S‑Reifen reichen nicht für die ganze Strecke.

Wichtigste Punkte (womit Sie eine Strafe vermeiden):
- Deutschland: Bei winterlichen Straßenverhältnissen gelten nur Winterreifen mit dem Alpine‑Symbol (3PMSF). M+S allein gilt in Deutschland seit 01.10.2024 nicht mehr. (Gesetz: §2 StVO / §36 StVZO) [§2 StVO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/stvo_2013/__2.html)  
- Österreich: In der Saison 1. Nov – 15. Apr sind bei winterlichen Verhältnissen Winterreifen mit M+S oder 3PMSF (≥4 mm) auf allen Rädern Pflicht; Ketten auf Antriebsrädern möglich, wenn Straße komplett verschneit/vereist. Ihre Reisedaten (20.12. & 03.01.) fallen in diesen Zeitraum. [oesterreich.gv.at](https://www.oesterreich.gv.at/en/themen/mobilitaet/kfz/10/2/Seite.063100)  
- Rumänien: Pflicht bei Schnee/Eis/schwarzem Eis; hier werden M+S‑gekennzeichnete Reifen akzeptiert. [MAI Rumänien / OUG 195/2002] (https://www.mai.gov.ro/precizari-privind-anvelopele-de-iarna/)  

Was Sie jetzt tun müssen:
- Montieren Sie vor der Abfahrt Winterreifen mit dem Alpine‑Symbol (3PMSF) auf alle Räder. Das erfüllt Deutschland und Österreich; ansonsten riskieren Sie Bußgelder (Deutschland: ab ~60–80 EUR + Punkt; Österreich: Geldbußen bis deutlich höher). Quellen oben.  
- Für München: bestellen Sie die grüne Umweltplakette vor der Fahrt (Ihr Euro‑5 Diesel ist zulässig, Plakette aber Pflicht zum Einfahren). [Stadt München – Umweltzone](https://stadt.muenchen.de/infos/umweltzone-muenchen.html)  
- Grundausstattung prüfen: Warnwesten, Verbandkasten, Warndreieck sind Pflicht in AT/RO; Ketten dabei haben ist nützlich, ersetzt aber keine 3PMSF‑Reifen in DE.  

Quellen: §2 StVO / §36 StVZO (DE), oesterreich.gv.at + BMIMI (AT), MAI / OUG 195/2002 (RO), Stadt München (Umweltplakette).
A blog says Germany now has a car toll and the Austrian vignette is only valid 18 days after buying. True?

Short answer — both claims are wrong, but for different reasons.

- Germany: false. There is no car/vignette toll for vehicles up to 3.5 t. The proposed Pkw‑Maut was struck down by the Court of Justice (2019) and, as of 2026, no car toll is planned [ECJ ruling; dataset summary].  
  Source: ECJ case C‑591/17 (Austria v Germany) — see the ruling and summaries (Court of Justice / national law).

- Austria: partly true but misleading. There is an 18‑day delay only for online purchases of the 2‑month and annual digital vignette (consumer‑protection/right‑of‑withdrawal reason). 1‑day and 10‑day vignettes are immediately valid, and any vignette (including annual/2‑month) bought at a sales office, vending machine or toll station is immediately valid too. The common blog claim that "all vignettes are only valid 18 days after buying" is incorrect.  
  Source: ASFINAG (digital vignette purchase & validity, including the 18‑day online delay) — https://www.asfinag.at/maut-vignette/vignette/digitale-vignette/ and ASFINAG FAQ.

(If you want, I can link the exact ECJ and ASFINAG pages.)
Which Hungarian county vignettes cover the M1 from Budapest to Hegyeshalom, and is there a cheaper option?

Short answer — which decides if you get fined:
- The M1 between Budapest and Hegyeshalom runs through Pest, Fejér, Komárom‑Esztergom and Győr‑Moson‑Sopron counties. You may legally cover it by buying the four county e‑vignettes for those counties (each county product available) or by the new M1 regional county bundle that covers all four. (Sources below.)
- Cheaper option: the M1 regional e‑vignette (covers Pest + Fejér + Komárom‑Esztergom + Győr‑Moson‑Sopron) costs 15,000 HUF on 2026‑09‑29; single county vignettes are 7,190 HUF each. The regional sticker is therefore the lower-cost legal choice for the whole M1 route.  
What to do before leaving:
- Buy the M1 regional e‑vignette (or the needed county vignettes) on the official site before driving: https://ematrica.nemzetiutdij.hu/ — e‑vignettes are effective immediately (no online delay).  
Penalties: surcharge rules shown on the official pages (surcharges if unpaid).  
Sources: Magyar Közút (official price list and M1 regional product) — https://nemzetiutdij.hu/api/uploads/e_matrica_arak_2026_pdf_611db0ecc1.pdf and https://nemzetiutdij.hu/hu/hirek/tisztazzuk-a-felreerteseket-az-m1-regionalis-matrica-kapcsan.
